title: U Mass - Glucose Measurement Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xw5fpg6
materials: When value is reached, accept calibration.
The final calculated value should be ~144 mg/dl.

steps.title: Prepare Instrument and Reagents
steps.instruction: Check the waste and fill the glucose reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Prepare Standard Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare approximately 0.1ml of standard solution (~144 mg/dl).

steps.title: Cycle the Analox Analyzer
steps.instruction: Press “Enter”, and then “No” to cycle the Analox Analyzer.

steps.title: Stabilize Baseline
steps.instruction: Wait for the reading to return to ~0 mg/dl (±1mg/dl) after cycling is finished.

steps.title: Perform Initial Calibration Injection
steps.instruction: Inject 10 µl of standard solution using a precision pipet.

steps.title: Verify Calibration Value
steps.instruction: Once the reading returns to ~0 mg/dl, inject 10 µl of standard solution and ensure the value is ~144 mg/dl.

steps.title: Stabilize Calibration
steps.instruction: Repeat the injection and rinsing process until the calibration value is stable.

steps.title: Check Calibration Accuracy
steps.instruction: Verify calibration by injecting 5 µl of standard and multiplying the reported value by 2.

steps.title: Measure Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Use 5 or 10 µl of plasma sample for glucose concentration measurement.
